# KeMU Digital Repository

> Kenya Methodist University's comprehensive digital repository preserving and providing access to scholarly research, theses, journal articles, and institutional knowledge.

The KeMU Digital Repository serves as the central hub for Kenya Methodist University's academic and research outputs, including graduate theses, peer-reviewed publications, conference proceedings, and specialized collections in health sciences. The repository utilizes Creative Commons licensing and metadata organization to ensure broad accessibility and discoverability of scholarly materials.

## Graduate Research Collections

- [Doctorate Theses and Dissertations](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/155): Repository of doctoral theses from KeMU's schools and research programs
- [Masters Theses and Dissertations](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/6): Collection of master's theses from KeMU's schools and graduate programs
- [Strategy Implementation, Corporate Governance and Performance of Road Projects Under Kenya Rural Roads Authority in Kenya](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/2277): PhD thesis on Kenya Rural Roads Authority strategy and governance
- [The Effect of Financial Sensitization and Internal Audit Practices On Financial Performance in Public Universities, Kenya](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/2276): PhD research on financial management in Kenyan public universities
- [Improving Health Systems Responsiveness Among Chronic Care Centers in Selected Tier Three Hospitals in Kenya](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/2275): Study on health systems responsiveness and worker training in Kenyan hospitals
- [Understanding The Socio-Economic Determinants of Family Planning Service Utilization Among Women of Reproductive Age In Eldas Sub-County](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/2278): Research study on family planning and reproductive health in Eldas Sub-County

## Scholarly Publications

- [Journal Articles](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/313): KeMU scholars' journal articles including International Journal of Professional Practice
- [The International Journal of Professional Practice](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/333): Kenya Methodist University's peer-reviewed interdisciplinary research journal
- [Books and Book Chapters](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/122): Collection of books and book chapters from KeMU Digital Repository
- [Conference Proceedings, Papers, Workshops, Seminars and Trainings](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/132): Academic conference proceedings and training materials from KeMU

## Research Collections & Archives

- [KeMU Digital Repository Home](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke): Kenya Methodist University's digital repository for scholarly outputs and research archives
- [Archives](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/125): Browse and explore KeMU Digital Repository's archived research collections
- [Recently Added](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/recent-submissions): Recently submitted research papers and scholarly publications to KeMU repository
- [KeMU Digital Health Repository](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/281): Specialized digital repository for health-related research and African Digital Health Library

## Academic Discourse

- [Lectures and Speeches](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/86): Archived lectures and speeches from KeMU faculty and leadership
- [Influence of Kenya's Military Engagement in Somalia on the Achievement of Kenya's National Interests](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/2274): Research on Kenya's military engagement in Somalia and national security

## Optional Resources

- [Institution Photos](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/1066): Collection of Kenya Methodist University institutional photographs
- [Kenya Methodist University Policies](http://repository.kemu.ac.ke/handle/123456789/89): Official KeMU institutional policies and regulatory documentation
